question.text: Consider a parallel plate capacitor of area A (of each plate) and separation 'd' between the plates. If $E$ is the electric field and $\varepsilon_0$ is the permittivity of free space between the plates, then potential energy stored in the capacitor is

solution.text:
We know energy density
$\rho_{\mathrm{av}}=\frac{1}{2} \varepsilon_0 E^2$
So potential energy $=\rho_{a v} \times$ Volume
$\Rightarrow \text { P.E. }=\frac{1}{2} \varepsilon_0 E^2 A d$
